d: Oscar tries to cure Felix of his fear of flying so he can cover a major photographic assignment.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.

st: The Sound of the Trumpets of Conscience Falls Deafly on a Brain That Holds Its Ears...
d: Rob struggles between his civic duty and fear for his family's safety when he believes he can identify the two robbers in a jewelry store holdup.
It's the first Christmas presentation of 'The Alan Brady Show' where he turns the spotlight upon his talented staff to entertain the TV public.

st: The Third One from the Left
d: A young chorus girl on 'The Alan Brady Show' falls desperately in love with Rob.

st: My Husband Is the Best One
d: Rob's job is threatened by a news article praising him more than Alan for the success of 'The Alan Brady Show.'

st: The Lady and the Tiger and the Lawyer
d: When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.

st: The Life and Love of Joe Coogan
d: Rob is overwhelmed by jealousy when he meets one of Laura's old flames and later discovers that she saved a box of love poems he sent her.

st: A Nice, Friendly Game of Cards
d: A social game of poker turns sour when it's discovered Rob has been playing with a marked deck.

st: Happy Birthday and Too Many More
d: When Laura and Rob give Ritchie a birthday party, 63 screaming kids cause a ruckus at the Petrie house.
Rob consults a psychiatrist to determine whether a series of mysterious ailments are psychosomatic.
Socialite Clara Watkins is an important guest at Shady Rest. Unless she recommends the place to her friends, the bank won't lend Kate any more money.
Everyone seems too busy to spend any time with Charley, so he decides to quit his job as engineer of the Hooterville Cannonball.
Railroad President Norman Curtis thinks that his household's pet basset hound needs a change of scenery, so he sends the dog off to Shady Rest.
Kate Bradley is visited by an old schoolmate who's now a millionaire, but Uncle Joe has him pegged as a con artist.
Homer Bedloe returns to Hooterville with his son, Homer Junior, who is as hateful and devious as his father.
Business executive Mary Jane Hastings returns home to Hooterville and impresses everyone with her administrative ability, particularly her handling of men.
Shady Rest would stand a better chance of being selected as the site of the big convention if Kate were around, but she's trapped in a cave-in.
Kate is trying to get Shady Rest chosen as the site for a big convention, but a sprained ankle has incapacitated her and the job of cornering the convention is left to Uncle Joe and the daughters.
When Adelaide "Genghis" Keane returns from Europe, Kate is surprised to find that the elderly schoolteacher is no longer the tyrannical disciplinarian she used to be.
Folks at the Shady Rest hotel find Betty Jo extremely changed after a trip to Europe[her graduation present].

Gomer wins a trip for two to Las Vegas and takes Sergeant Carter with him. The Sergeant has no money so he has to rely on Gomer for entertainment but Gomer has set an itinerary which include things like visiting a Rock Museum.
Opie Taylor runs away from Mayberry to join the Marines.

st: A Date with Miss Camp Henderson
d: A bet between sergeants and Sergeant Carter's lies result in Gomer dating Miss Camp Henderson and taking her to Lookout Point.
Both Gomer and Sergeant Carter are conned by an old bum.

Sergeant Carter takes a temporary desk job writing training manuals and considers making it permanent when he sees the platoon does fine without him; so Gomer messes things up to bring the Sergeant back.

Sergeant Carter is in a restaurant with a girl other than his girlfriend when he foils an armed robbery. The Sergeant doesn't want his girlfriend to know he was there with another woman so he pins the credit on Gomer.
Gomer gets his first shot at the obstacle course.
Gomer helps a recruit smuggle his girlfriend into the barracks.
While on a hike Gomer makes a friend, but when the friend decides to move into the barracks Sgt Carter wants him gone! but Gomer shows the sergeant what an asset this new friend is to the platoon.
After tipping his hat instead of saluting female Captain "Iron Pants" Martin, Gomer is assigned special detail in her office to teach him a lesson.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fiancé stood him up at the alter on their big day.
